Product · AI Design System in a Box

A design system your AI tools can follow.

Your teams now generate UI with Cursor, Claude Code, Figma Make, Lovable and Bolt. Without a system those tools can read, every prompt drifts further from your brand. I package your tokens, components and rules into an agent readable system, set it up in your repository, and hand it over working. Fixed scope, fixed price, about six weeks.

Book a call See pricing

About 6 weeks

from kickoff to a working system

Fixed price

three packages, no hourly billing

Every major tool

Claude Code, Cursor, Figma MCP and more

AI generated UI is fast. It is also making things up.

When an agent cannot find your system, it improvises, and every improvisation becomes design debt someone has to clean up.

  • A

    Hardcoded colors and spacing everywhere.

    Agents guess hex values and pixel sizes instead of using your tokens, so theming and dark mode break.

  • B

    Components that do not exist.

    The AI writes a new button or modal rather than using the one you already have, and the library splinters.

  • C

    Accessibility quietly regresses.

    Contrast, focus states and labels are the first things generated code skips.

  • D

    Your documentation is written for people, not agents.

    A component site and a wiki page are not something an agent can reliably act on.

One repository. Everything an agent needs to build on brand.

A single entry point manifest tells any AI tool where your tokens, components, icons and rules live. No more pasting links into prompts.

01

Token architecture

Primitive, semantic and component tokens, synced between Figma Variables and code.

02

Agent manifest

A single instructions file that every major AI coding tool reads first.

03

Custom skills

Ready made skills for building screens, auditing UI and writing developer handoff specifications.

04

Governance checks

Automated checks that flag hardcoded values, invented components and accessibility misses in every pull request.

A fixed path from audit to handoff.

Week 1

Audit

  • Token and component inventory

Weeks 2 to 3

Structure

Token architecture, component specifications and the agent manifest.

  • Tokens in Figma and code
  • Agent readable specifications

Weeks 4 to 5

Wire up

Connect your tools and add skills and governance checks.

  • Tool configuration
  • Skills and policy checks

Week 6

Prove and hand off

Re run the baseline to show the difference, then train your team.

  • Before and after drift report
  • Team workshop and documentation

Things people usually ask.

We do not have a design system yet. Is this for us?

Yes. Foundation is built for exactly that. We start from your product as it exists and set up the agent readable structure from day one, which is easier than retrofitting later.

Does it work with our component library?

The tokens, manifest and specifications do not depend on a framework. Component specifications point at your real code, whatever you build it in.

Why fixed price?

Because the scope is well understood. You know what you are paying and what you get, and I carry the risk of the estimate.
